name: Browserless
description: A headless Chrome browser as a service.
composeYaml:
services:
  browserless:
    image: ghcr.io/browserless/chromium:latest
    environment:
      - TOKEN=${BROWSERLESS_PASSWORD}
    expose:
      - 3000
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
